title: Beat
description: Single narrative beat within a scene: the smallest unit of dramatic change. Shots are designed to land beats, so every beat states its intent, conflict, and turn.

order.description: Position of the beat within the scene, 1-based.

intent.description: What the driving character wants in this beat.

conflict.description: What resists the intent — obstacle, doubt, or opposing want.

turn.description: How the situation changes by the end of the beat; the reason the beat exists.

summary.description: One-line description of the on-screen action.

emotional_shift.description: Audience-facing emotional change the beat produces.
